subject: Consolidation instructions for backordered attendee kits (pins OOS)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@brightlinepromos.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Attendee kit status — enamel pin backorder

Hi Sergio / Monica,

Wanted to flag a supply issue that just came up on our end. The enamel lapel pin (SKU BP-PIN-001) that was scheduled to be kitted into 600 attendee kits is on an unexpected production hold — the plating supplier delayed batch runs. ETA for the new pins is currently the week of Mar 8 (best case).

Options we can do now:
- Ship the core kits (lanyard, sticker, tote, sticker sheet, insert card) on Mar 3 for venue arrival by Mar 5 and ship the pins separately when they arrive (split shipment). Additional freight cost: estimate +$420.
- Substitute pins with an upgraded woven lanyard at no extra charge for up to 600 units if you approve. We can finalize proofs and ship everything together by Mar 3.
- Hold entire kit until pins arrive (delay delivery to Mar 10+).

I've attached the updated quote and a quick lanyard proof (final-proof-lanyard_v3.pdf, vendor-quote-Brightline-20270220.pdf). If you prefer split shipments, we can stage at Horizon Freight's hub in Franklin for final-mile consolidation to the venue.

Please let us know which route you want to take — we can expedite pins when the plating slot opens but it will incur rush tooling freight (~$650).

Apologies for the scramble. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Account Manager | Brightline Promotions
attachments: vendor-quote-Brightline-20270220.pdf (pdf), final-proof-lanyard_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@brightlinepromos.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Attendee kit status — enamel pin backorder

Thanks for the update, Lena — appreciate the transparency. A few quick questions before we sign off: 

1) If we accept the woven lanyard substitution, can you confirm material, color match to the attached proof, and confirm it will include the same badge clip as the pin option (we need them to clip into the acrylic badge sleeve)?
2) For split shipments: can Horizon hold pallets and do one last-mile delivery to the venue on March 5? What's the earliest we can get a consolidated ETA (door to door)?
3) If we go split: please provide a detailed packing list for both shipments (which SKUs, units per box/pallet, dims/weight) — we need this for customs and venue check-in.
4) Cost delta for split (line item) vs substitution vs holding.

Event timeline: venue load-in Mar 5 (09:00–16:00). If pins arrive Mar 8+, they miss load-in window and we'd need an on-site hand-carry or courier. If substitution ships with main kit and arrives by Mar 5, that's preferred.

Monica / Marcus — can you confirm whether staging at Horizon Freight (Franklin hub) or direct to Moscone Center (venue) is better logistically for you? Also confirm cost center for this PO (events ops).

If we can get the lanyard proof matched and a formal proforma, we can approve today.

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@brightlinepromos.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Attendee kit status — enamel pin backorder

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below: 

1) Woven lanyard: 100% polyester, pantone 2945C dye-sub (matches Redwood blue on proof v3). It includes a standard metal lobster clip (compatible with acrylic badge sleeves). We can include a reinforced stitched end as shown on the proof.

2) Horizon: yes — we use Horizon Freight as our preferred consolidation partner in the region. They can receive two pallets and guarantee final-mile to Moscone on Mar 5 for the quoted rate. Earliest consolidated ETA to venue if we ship to Horizon on Mar 3 is Mar 5 EOD (their SLA).

3) Packing list (high level):
- Kit shipment (ship date Mar 3): 600 tote bags (20 CTN / 30 per box), 600 sticker sheets (30 CTN), 600 insert cards (30 CTN), 600 woven lanyards (24 CTN), 50 promo tees (5 CTN) — total volume: 2 pallets, est. weight 740 lbs.
- Pin shipment (if split; ship when ready): 600 pins (5 CTN), total 1 carton, est. weight 18 lbs.

4) Costs (est):
- Substitution (lanyard) — no charge for the upgrade (we absorb material delta).
- Split shipment — additional freight and handling $420 (Brightline estimate).
- Rush pins (expedite tooling/freight) — $650.

I've attached a proforma for substitution + Horizon routing (proforma-invoice-20270221.pdf). If you approve substitution we will finalize proofs and print.

If you approve substitution now, we will hold production slot and ship everything together on Mar 3 (best outcome).

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Brightline Promotions
attachments: proforma-invoice-20270221.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@brightlinepromos.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 17:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Attendee kit status — enamel pin backorder

Thanks, Lena. After reviewing timing and exhibitor check-in constraints, Events Ops is approving the woven lanyard substitution for the 600 kits. Rationale: keeps load-in simple on Mar 5 and avoids courier risk.

Action items: 
- Sergio: please confirm PO charge to cost center EVENTS-OPS-23 and confirm we can sign the proforma.
- Marcus: please coordinate with Horizon Freight to receive two pallets on Mar 4 and schedule final-mile delivery to Moscone Center March 5 AM load-in window. Give them this PO and ask for the packing list Lena provided.
- Lena: please finalize the lanyard proof colors and issue the final pack list + proforma for signature (we will sign via DocuSign).

Monica Patel
Events Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
